name: Constable Kamlesh Kumari Yadav
real_life_parallel: Kamlesh Kumari Yadav — CRPF martyr, 2001 Parliament attack

biography.background: CRPF (Central Reserve Police Force) constable posted at Parliament House security. First to spot terrorists entering Parliament premises on 13 December 2001. Despite being unarmed, challenged the attackers, buying critical time for security response.
biography.sacrifice: Shot dead by terrorists; her alert and resistance allowed Parliament security to mobilize, preventing terrorists from reaching the main building where MPs were in session
biography.decoration: Ashoka Chakra (posthumous) — India's highest peacetime gallantry award to a woman
biography.film_1_role: 13 December 2001 Parliament attack sequence; martyrdom representation

parliament_attack.role: First responder challenge; prevented deeper penetration
parliament_attack.casualties: 5 terrorists, 6 police/security personnel including Kamlesh Kumari
parliament_attack.consequence: India-Pakistan military mobilization (Operation Parakram); Hamza infiltration rationale

oracle_note: Non-playable as query subject (deceased, security role not intelligence operative). Appears as historical context for 2001 Parliament attack motivation.
